aiTitle: The Diaper Run and the Partner Lunch

message.content: Hey. I’m staring at Ada right now, she’s finally asleep, and I need to get the grocery list sorted for tomorrow. I’m exhausted.

content.text: I can help with that, Daniel. What’s running low at home? I can pull up your usual staples or suggest a quick meal plan if you want to cook.

message.content: Let’s do both. I need milk, diapers, and baby food pouches. But also, I need to figure out what I’m eating for lunch tomorrow because I have to go into the office.

content.text: Noted. For lunch tomorrow, since you’re going in, would you like me to book a table or just pull up the usual spot you go to for client meetings?

message.content: No, I’m meeting the partners. It’s the quarterly review. My firm partner lunch is 2026-03-31.

content.text: Got it. I’ll block out 12:30 PM for that meeting. Since you’re on parental leave, I’ve kept the rest of the day open unless you want to tackle some paperwork? Also, I see you’ve adjusted your sleep schedule recently.

message.content: Yeah, I had to. I’ve switched the sleep pattern to two 3-hour blocks. It’s the only way I’m getting any work done before Grace gets back. Can you just add the groceries to the cart? And maybe a coffee to go?

content.text: Done. I’ve added the full-size pack of diapers, organic whole milk, and the turkey and sweet potato pouches to your cart. I’ve also scheduled a pickup for 6:00 PM tomorrow. The coffee is set for 11:00 AM at the café near the office. Anything else?

message.content: No, that’s it. Thanks. Just keep an eye on the time for the lunch. I don’t want to be late.

content.text: I will send a reminder 30 minutes before. Rest well, Daniel.
